excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个巢穴，这个巢穴是由该星球的土生大型掠食动物集群建造的。

许多[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[Root.GetLeaderName]能带领幸存者们抵达安全地点前失散了。
excerpt.en:
A group of large predators indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] were recently discovered to have made a lair in the ruins being excavated.

Many [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were lost before [Root.GetLeaderName] could lead the survivors to safety.
